item.text: {"question_id":"1B.10","answer":"For 2023, the supplied evidence does not demonstrate that Mexico left a safer and more durable overall existential-risk posture than it inherited. There is meaningful risk-reducing continuity and some target-year activity: Mexico’s TPNW ratification predated the period but remained in force, its government advocated nuclear disarmament and risk reduction, voted for a UN resolution prohibiting nuclear use, updated its 1540 assistance request, and participated in a 2023 biological-weapons non-proliferation peer review (BATCH-0044-E001; BATCH-0043-E004; BATCH-0040-E002; BATCH-0020-E006). Nuclear-safety systems also included corrective-action, emergency-preparedness, spent-fuel, and post-Fukushima measures, although most documented systems predated 2023, some work remained incomplete or unverified, and authority lay mainly with CNSNS, CFE, SENER, and other state institutions rather than demonstrably with López Obrador personally (BATCH-0002-E004; BATCH-0002-E009; BATCH-0002-E010; BATCH-0002-E011; BATCH-0002-E013). The 2023 thefts of radioactive sources, each involving degradation of defence in depth, show unresolved radiological exposure; one was recovered with improved security verified, while the other report does not establish preventive controls or subsequent correction (BATCH-0040-E011; BATCH-0038-E002). In the cyber and dual-use domains, serious military and federal cybersecurity weaknesses, surveillance-related accountability concerns, and institutional gaps were documented, but the supplied record does not establish a complete 2018-to-2023 causal comparison or prove that López Obrador personally directed each failure (BATCH-0047-E010; BATCH-0011-E005; BATCH-0014-E006; BATCH-0026-E020; BATCH-0052-E024). The defensible conclusion is therefore a mixed, only partially documented end-state: durable inherited nuclear and radiological safeguards with some continuing implementation and diplomatic restraint, alongside unresolved safety, cyber, institutional, and dual-use exposure. A safer overall before-and-after outcome is not
